title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit — Survival, Reproduction, Illusion #Shorts
description:
The selfish-gene reading of Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit makes it less romantic and far more precise. Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit is a 2005 stop-motion animated comedy horror film directed by Nick Park and Steve Box and written by Park, Box, Mark Burton and Bob Baker. Produced by DreamWorks Animation and Aardman Features, it is the fourth instalment in the Wallace & Gromit series and the first to be feature-length.

Behind Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. A companion game, also titled Curse of the Were-Rabbit, was released with the film. The Curse of the Were-Rabbit was the final DreamWorks Animation film released on VHS.
